notes.title: PLAY THE DEMO AND SUPPORT THE DEVS — KICKSTARTER IS LIVE!
notes.content:
It's time! The demo is finally released, so grab a beverage, get comfy in your gaming chair and embark on a quest to get into Fade's head (well, eye) and save her from the Gloom! And after you finish it, please consider supporting our Kickstarter campaign that has also just launched!

A couple of things you need to know about the demo:

 The demo is approximately 20-30 minutes long; it has 3 endings and 3 corresponding achievements.
 It is Windows only, but people have pretty successfully run it on Linux and Steam Deck before.

And also, some info about the Kickstarter:

 The Early Bird tier, which will get you a Steam copy of DOWNHILL for only £8, will be available for the first 72 hours of the campaign.
 There are several exclusive digital rewards, but also a lot of ways to add your own content into the game, ranging from having your pet immortalized in DOWNHILL to co-designing an entire boss with all their attacks!
 The campaign will be live for 30 days.
 Your support during the first couple of days will have a massive influence on the overall success of the campaign! That's just how the algo works.
 During the campaign, we will be doing lore deep dives, Q&As and more fun stuff that we'll reveal later!!

Join our Discord community to leave feedback (if you'd like to!) and become a part of this magical journey called indie game development. We have a pretty neat fandom that will welcome you with open arms!

Have fun playing the demo!

- love, Sisterhood

notes.title: PLAY THE DEMO AND SUPPORT ON KICKSTARTER - JUNE 4TH
notes.content:
We've been waiting for it, you've been waiting for it, and now the time has finally come! Our demo will be released on June 4th! Make sure not to miss it - it's a first-ever glimpse of what DOWNHILL is going to be like.

Moreover, we're launching our Kickstarter campaign on the same day! We've been working on this game for a while, but your financial support could help us truly focus on the development and finish making DOWNHILL as soon as possible.

If you aren't following us on Kickstarter, please consider doing so! This way you will be notified on the launch and won't miss the discounted Early Bird tier that will get you a copy of DOWNHILL at a lower price. There will also be a ton of backer-exclusive rewards available, so make sure to check out their list when the campaign is live!

We're so excited to finally begin this journey - and use it as an opportunity to grow closer with our community. Hope you're excited too!

- love, Sisterhood

notes.title: We're on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hi! We've been working on DOWNHILL for a while now, and we're finally ready to get our supporters involved in the process. Expect a lot of cool rewards, interesting updates and an exciting journey to be a part of! Whether you become a backer or share our link with someone else who might, we appreciate your support ♡

Follow us on Kickstarter!

- love, Sisterhood

notes.title: Be the first one to play the DOWNHILL demo!
notes.content:
Our Discord server is finally live! Join in the first month to be assigned a special OG role and get your demo key! Only until February 18th (or until we run out of keys). So hurry up if you want to be one of the first people to play it!

Join now!
